facts.fact: 一辆黄色跑车斜横在柏油路面上，成了押运车的路障
facts.anchor: An expensive yellow roadster slung diagonally across the asphalt

facts.fact: 探员拧动钥匙，引爆了六月绑在跑车底盘上的那一大块C4
facts.anchor: triggering the generous block of C4 June had strapped to the roadster’s undercarriage

facts.fact: 中枪之后，她在借用的身体断气之前换了一具
facts.anchor: swapping bodies before the first one died

facts.fact: 车尾长凳上绑着一个蒙眼、双手被捆、手腕插着输液管的女孩
facts.anchor: She was strapped to the bench, blindfolded and hands bound, an IV running into her wrist.

facts.fact: 那女孩有悉妮的金发与心形脸，却不是悉妮
六月曾顶替悉妮那位已经死去的姐姐留下的位置
facts.anchor: stepping into the vacant role because the original was dead

facts.fact: 六月在老家餐馆往咖啡里倒第十三包糖时，门口的铃响了
facts.anchor: She was on her thirteenth pouch when the bell over the door sang its little song.
